title: OCO index hour code M (13/4, 13D)
prompt: Two rows put M in the hour column: 13/4 'Ecce quomodo computati' place TP, and 13D 'Quisquis enim' place 'a ad lib'. M is a place code (Magnificat), not an hour, in the legend. 2 index row(s). Examples: #1256 'Ecce quomodo computati' 13/4|M|TP p1042; #2577 'Quisquis enim' 13D|M|a ad lib p470. Legend OCO pp1210-1213 does not define this code. Rows with it are held: the mapper (oco/oco_sigla.py) gives no lit_part_sources target, so identity can load but the assignment waits. Answer = what the code means and where the chant goes (service.part, epoch, option_txt). Carry-out: add the rule to oco_sigla.py, re-run oco/load_oco_lps.py, record it in oco/specs/README.md 'User rulings'.
